Anna K: Quick heads-up — FinEdge asked for a short, customer-facing playbook for tenant provisioning. They want to know: RBAC roles created, audit log fields, KMS envelope usage, and the flow for temporary onboarding creds. Can someone sketch and I’ll turn into the doc?

Mike L: I can take a first pass. Do we have a single source-of-truth for the tenant-provisioning flow? @Samir R did infra change this recently?

Samir R: Yes — infra updated the flow last quarter. Short summary: service 'provisioner' calls provisioning API -> creates tenant record -> provisions tenant-scoped service account (role: tenant-admin-lite) -> creates tenant KMS envelope key reference -> writes audit event to platform-audit topic. Exports to customer SIEM if they enabled log forwarding.

Mike L: Nice. Can you paste a minimal example of the audit event payload we emit? Customer specifically asked for fields.

Samir R: Sure — minimal example we send (redacted):
```json
{
  "event": "tenant.provisioned",
  "tenant_id": "ten_12345",
  "actor": "provisioner-service",
  "service_account": "sa_ten_12345",
  "roles": ["tenant-admin-lite"],
  "kms_key_id": "arn:kms:us-west-2:acct:key/abcd-ef01",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-12T15:22:11Z",
  "request_id": "req-6b2c...",
  "ip": "34.201.12.5",
  "notes": "onboarding flow, temp-creds-ttl=3600"
}
```

Keiko H: Two things FinEdge usually asks about: 1) how long temp creds last, 2) proof of key rotation/rotation cadence. Our default temp onboarding token TTL is 1 hour (3600s) and we issue short-lived service tokens; we recommend customer rotate after first successful connection.

Anna K: Great — what's the default log retention for enterprise customers vs self-serve? FinEdge is enterprise.

Samir R: Enterprise: 365 days on platform by default (we can extend per contract). Self-serve: 90 days. We also provide signed log export to customer S3/SIEM on request.

Mike L: For KMS, they asked whether we use envelope encryption and if they can bring their own key (BYOK). Short answer: yes to envelope encryption; we support customer-managed keys via KMS BYOK/HSM in Dedicated/Private. For hosted we use Redwood-managed keys by default unless configured.

Anna K: Can you draft the exact wording for customer-facing doc re: BYOK + audit proof? They want to see a minimal proof they can give to their auditors.

Samir R: Draft snippet: "Redwood uses tenant-scoped envelope keys. For Dedicated/Private deployments customers may provide a KMS key (BYOK) or HSM-protected key. Key IDs and rotation metadata are recorded in the tenant provisioning audit event and are available via the evidence export API. Rotation events include previous_key_id, new_key_id, rotated_by, rotation_timestamp."

Keiko H: Also add: we keep a signed rotation history export (HMAC-signed) for enterprise contracts for up to contractually agreed retention. For SIEM/forensics they can request the export job `audit:export --tenant ten_12345 --since 2025-01-01`.

Mike L: Throwing in a small checklist for the playbook: 1) Provision tenant (service creates SA + roles) 2) Confirm KMS envelope created / BYOK configured 3) Verify audit event present on platform-audit topic 4) Trigger evidence export -> signed bundle 5) Exchange temp creds over out-of-band (we recommend SFTP or encrypted email) 6) Rotate temp creds after first use.

Anna K: Can we show an example evidence export command and sample return metadata? FinEdge will want to see the field names.

Samir R: Example export command (internal CLI):
```bash
redwood audit export --tenant ten_12345 --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-02-12 --signed --dest s3://finedge-evidence
```
Sample metadata returned: `{
  "export_id": "exp_9f1a",
  "signed": true,
  "hmac": "sha256:...",
  "objects": ["audit-2026-02-12.ndjson.gz"],
  "key_rotation_events": [{"previous_key_id":"k1","new_key_id":"k2","timestamp":"2026-02-10T12:00:00Z"}]
}`

sec-bot: Note: For any request involving BYOK/HSM please open a support ticket with tagging `enterprise-compliance` and attach customer Onboarding Checklist v3.2.

Keiko H: One more nuance for the doc: temp service account scopes are intentionally narrow. If customer needs broader privileges we recommend a separate long-lived role with explicit approvals and audit beats.

Mike L: I'll assemble this into a short two-page playbook with the checklist, audit event example, CLI export example, TTLs, and KMS notes. Will ping here with a doc link.

Anna K: Perfect — can you try to get a draft by EOD? FinEdge scheduled their security review next Tue. :calendar:

Mike L: Yes — tagging @Keiko H for review once done.

Samir R: Pushed a short internal doc draft to https://redwood.internal/docs/tenant-provisioning-playbook (internal). PTAL when Mike posts the customer PDF.

Anna K: Thanks all :thumbsup:
